title: Crack Johnson, drummer in the Ringling tent
summary: Jones describes Crack Johnson, an Oklahoma drummer resembling Jack Johnson, who played in the big tent with Sousa.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Meanwhile there was a black man that looked exactly like Jack Johnson. He was from Oklahoma. His name was Crack Johnson. Crack Johnson played in the big tent with John Philip Sousa.
With John Philip Sousa. They had him in the big show, under the big tent.
